findings.detail: Rows 176398, 176399, and 176400 carry fair_value_currency U_CAD even though the AAG KP Borrower LLC fair value cells are in the dollar-denominated Fair Value column and the source rows show no CAD marker.

rationale: FX02 is a Class 1 currency/unit check on fair_value_currency. The flagged rows store U_CAD, but the raw source schedule for AAG KP Borrower LLC is in table 51 under the Fair Value dollar column, and rows 26-28 show fair values 23,950, (47), and (4) with no CAD indicator. The raw source therefore supports USD-denominated fair values, making the U_CAD extraction a real data error.
